$comment: Fixes knext bundles for vinext ahead of upstream releases. `vinext` is the ONLY version these patches were validated against; `pristine` records the sha256 of each target file in that published tarball. Bumping the vinext pin without re-porting and re-validating every patch fails vinext-patches.test.ts.

patches.summary: Server builds: a `require()` of a CommonJS dependency resolves the package's `require` export condition when Vite would just externalize that package (Next.js's default server-external packages and `serverExternalPackages` stay external; a bundler `external` or a plugin's own resolution still wins). Maintainer's version.
Nitro builds: a `turbopack.resolveExtensions` list without `.mjs` no longer hides Nitro's own preset entry (the build failed to resolve it).
Nitro builds: dependencies of the RSC environment are bundled, so a package's `react-server` export condition is honoured.

Nitro builds: React and react-dom are always traced into the server output, so a bundled CommonJS dependency such as styled-jsx (`<style jsx>`) shares the server's single React copy instead of loading a second one and failing with an invalid-hook-call error, including after the output directory is moved. Open upstream.

Nitro builds: `outputFileTracingIncludes` / `outputFileTracingExcludes` from next.config are applied to the traced server dependencies, with Next.js route-key and glob semantics. Maintainer's version.

App Router: a GET/HEAD request for an unmatched path whose `Sec-Fetch-Dest` is a non-HTML subresource destination (image, font, script, ...) gets a plain-text 404 instead of the rendered not-found page.

next/image: a custom `loader` prop gets the built-in loader's per-breakpoint `srcSet` treatment (quality passed through as given, not forced to 75; fill images, inline sources and overrideSrc handled like Next.js), in both the Image component and getImageProps. Narrowed for vinext 1.3.0, which ships the upstream PR's `trailingSlash` half of the image endpoint path. The upstream PR's `images.loaderFile` half is vinext-3686-image-loaderfile.patch.

next/image: `images.loaderFile` in next.config is honoured (the vinext plugin aliases the loader slot to the file, `next/image` applies it to every image, and a missing file or an incompatible `images.loader` fails the build like Next.js); `images.loader: "custom"` without a loader throws Next.js's missing-loader error. Server Components calling getImageProps get the configured loader too (a server-safe wrapper module beside the client entry). Applies on top of the patch above.

A hashbang-prefixed module (`#!/usr/bin/env node`) that also uses CommonJS syntax no longer fails to build — the CJS interop transform's prepended runtime facade used to push `#!` out of byte position 0; the displaced hashbang is now commented out (transform wrapper and client dependency optimizer). Maintainer's version.

A server action's redirect, when invoked via fetch (the client-side router path), now always answers HTTP 200 like Next.js does — it previously fell back to 303 unless the action had already been forwarded, the target was an ancestor/stale-sibling route, or the target ran on a different runtime. Header-only redirects are marked config-headers-applied so finalization cannot repeat them. The no-JS, progressive-enhancement form-POST redirect path is unchanged and still answers 303.

Nitro builds: `/_next/image` is served by vinext's image handler from the Nitro app (Next-style Cache-Control, a source-header allowlist, non-image sources rejected with 400, no Set-Cookie forwarding) instead of a 302 to the source asset, so a client sees the Next.js image headers. Split out of #3734 into its own upstream PR. Upstream #3741 differs from this port: it reads `images.minimumCacheTTL` from config and wires Nitro via a build-time `resolveImageSourceFetch` option; this patch keeps the behaviour knext shipped. Re-port to the final #3741 once it merges or is released.

Nitro builds, Pages Router: `/_next/image` is served through the running Nitro app (the same handler the App Router uses with the patch above) instead of answering 404 for want of a Workers ASSETS binding, so an image left on the default optimizer — including one an `images.loaderFile` sends to `/_next/image/` — loads; a recursive `url` gets Next.js's 400. Upstream #3741 covers the App Router only. Applies on top of the patch above.

tsconfig `paths` with several targets: when the first target does not resolve, the alias resolver tries the remaining targets in order (an import that only exists under `lib/b/*` of `"@lib/*": ["lib/a/*", "lib/b/*"]` used to fail the build), and a `.d.ts` target is never used as a module, as in TypeScript and Next.js. Open upstream (issue cloudflare/vinext#3756).

`import data from "./data" with { type: "json" }` on a file without a `.json` extension builds and loads the file as JSON, as webpack and Turbopack do (it used to fail with a parse error): a pre-transform appends `?lang.json` to such specifiers so Vite's JSON plugin handles them. Static imports, re-exports and dynamic imports. Open upstream (issue cloudflare/vinext#3757).

A `require()` in an `if`/`?:` branch that the environment's `process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME` define makes dead is no longer resolved (an instrumentation file with `else { await require("this should fail") }` used to fail the build): the CommonJS interop wrapper blanks such branches, keeping every offset, before vite-plugin-commonjs hoists their requires. Open upstream (issue cloudflare/vinext#3758).

Pages Router: the built server entry imports `_document`, then `_app`, then the page modules (Next.js module evaluation order), so side effects in a custom document run before the app's and the page's. Not yet merged upstream; retire when the pinned vinext includes cloudflare/vinext#2560.

Nitro builds, App Router: `experimental.inlineCss` inlines the stylesheets again. The inline-CSS manifest is injected into the RSC environment's real entry (its configured output directory), instead of a hard-coded `dist/server` that Nitro never writes, so the Nitro server sets `globalThis.__VINEXT_INLINE_CSS__`. Narrowed for vinext 1.3.0, which already reads the client stylesheets from the client environment's real output directory. Open upstream (issue cloudflare/vinext#3762); retire when the pinned vinext includes cloudflare/vinext#3763.

Nitro builds: with an absolute-URL `assetPrefix` that has a path (`https://cdn.example.com/sub`), the client bundles also answer at `/sub/_next/static/...` on the deployment origin, as with `next start`. The Nitro setup hook publishes the on-disk `_next/static` directory under the prefixed path as a fallthrough public asset (misses still reach vinext's middleware and plain-text 404), with Nitro's immutable cache rule unless the user set one. Open upstream (issue cloudflare/vinext#3765); retire when the pinned vinext includes cloudflare/vinext#3766.

App Router navigation scroll: adopts the Next.js 16.3 default scroll and focus handler. After a client navigation focus stays where it was (the navigated segment is not focused), the route content's highest client rect is measured against the root `scroll-padding-top` (so a fixed, sticky or display:none first child no longer picks the target, and a first node React hoists into <head> no longer suppresses scrolling to the top), and an intercepted route hands the scroll to its parallel slot instead of the retained page scrolling or blurring. Builds on cloudflare/vinext#2839 (scroll-padding-top) and keeps the `data-scroll-behavior` smooth-scroll opt-in around the scroll. Open upstream (issue cloudflare/vinext#2831); retire when the pinned vinext includes cloudflare/vinext#3768.

Hybrid app/ + pages/: a Pages route that resolves to `notFound` (getStaticProps/getServerSideProps `notFound`, or a `fallback: false` miss) renders the App Router not-found instead of pages/404, keeping the source route Cache-Control, as Next.js does when the app directory is enabled (Next.js deploy tests not-found-with-pages-i18n and pages-router-app-not-found). Production only; dev is unchanged. Open upstream (issue cloudflare/vinext#3428); retire when the pinned vinext includes cloudflare/vinext#3771.
